data.name: Parrotdome
data.detailed_description:
You’ve been called in to cover a night shift at the local bird conservatory. But when you find yourself sealed inside, it seems there’s something foul afoot. If you want to escape you’ll have to survive each hour until dawn.

Traverse the Dome

In this game you traverse a circular path around the dome to visit the different feeding stations. Explore the environment with point and click controls. Fixed camera angles are used to make sure every view is handcrafted.

The Food

Each food type has it’s own minigame and you’ll need to plan your trips accordingly. You have limited inventory space to carry food and you’ll have to play smart in order to prevent any one station from running out.

The Birds

The birds are hungry, fail to feed them enough and they will come for you. You’ll have to fend them off using your flashlight, but don’t feel too safe, each hour they become faster and more ravenous.

Survive Until Dawn

Each hour of the night is it’s own level. Complete each level by feeding the birds enough times, complete all 5 in order to escape the dome.

Features :

A vibrant cast of feathered friends, each with unique art, sound and a hand animated jumpscare

Adjustable difficulty

Secrets!

A custom scenario editor

data.short_description: In this point and click fixed camera horror adventure, traverse a tropical atrium to feed the ravenous birds before their hunger turns to you. Feed the parrots in a collection of food minigames, uncover secrets and wield your flashlight to fend off feathered foes.
